spec.description: Tier 3: one service - traces, latency, errors, logs, runtime, dependencies, resources.

spec.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name="$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__range]))))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name="$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Errors / s by route and status

spec.expr: sum by (http_route, http_response_status_code) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name="$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"[45].."}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.query: { resource.service.namespace = "$namespace" && resource.service.name = "$service" && kind = server && span.http.route =~ "${route:regex}" && status = error }

spec.expr: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name="$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name="$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[5m]))
histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name="$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[5m])))

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && kind = client && (span.db.system.name != nil || span.db.system != nil) } | rate() by (span.db.system.name, span.db.system)

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name="$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="$namespace", service_name="$service", instance=~"$instance", http_route=~"$route"}[5m])))

spec.query: { resource.service.namespace = "$namespace" && resource.service.name = "$service" && kind = server && span.http.route =~ "${route:regex}" && duration >= $min_duration && $status } && { $traceql }

spec.title: Runtime - JVM (no data until a Java service reports jvm.* metrics)
Runtime - Go (no data until a Go service reports go.* metrics)
